'''Business and economy'''
*[[2021–2022 inflation surge]], [[Economy of Japan]]
**It is announced that [[inflation]] in [[Japan]] reached 3.6% in October, which is the highest level of inflation recorded in the country [[1982 in Japan|since 1982]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2022/11/18/japans-inflation-soars-to-40-year-high (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Pakistan floods]]
**Twenty people are killed and 13 others are injured when a van falls off the [[Indus Highway]] in [[Sindh]], [[Pakistan]], into a flooded ditch. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/20-killed-van-accident-record-floods-haunt-pakistan-93539143 (ABC News)]
*[[2022 Nord Stream pipeline sabotage]]
**[[Sweden|Swedish]] authorities confirm intentional [[sabotage]] as the cause of the [[Nord Stream gas pipeline]] explosions after traces of explosives were found at the site of the leaks. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/traces-explosives-found-nord-stream-pipelines-sweden-says-2022-11-18/ (Reuters)]
*[[LATAM Perú Flight 2213]]
**A [[LATAM Airlines]] [[A320neo]] jet collides with a fire truck at [[Jorge Chávez International Airport]] in [[Lima]], [[Peru]], killing two firefighters and injuring 25 other people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/perus-international-airport-reports-accident-runway-says-passenger-unharmed-2022-11-18/ (Reuters)]

*''[[United States v. Elizabeth A. Holmes, et al.]]''
**[[Theranos]] founder and CEO [[Elizabeth Holmes]] is sentenced by a court in the U.S. state of California to more than 11 years in prison on four counts of fraud, and for misleading investors on the reliability of her company's technology. Her sentence will begin on April 27, 2023. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-63685131 (BBC News)]

[https://www.cnn.com/2022/11/18/politics/jack-smith-special-counsel (CNN)]

**The [[General Conference on Weights and Measures]] votes to stop synchronizing [[UTC]] to the standard [[mean solar time]] measurement [[UT1]] by [[2035]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/nov/18/do-not-adjust-your-clock-scientists-call-time-on-the-leap-second (''The Guardian'')]
